subject: Intro call request: Oliver Cox — Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call request: Oliver Cox — Redwood Inference

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for applying to the Infrastructure SWE role. I’m a recruiter on the hiring team at Redwood Inference and I’d love to schedule a 25–30 minute initial phone screen to learn more about your background and share a bit about the role and interview process.

Quick question first: which time zone are you in? If you’re in the UK, we can propose slots in BST — otherwise tell me your local offset and I’ll convert.

If helpful, I’m generally available next week in the following dayparts (your local time):
- Morning (08:00–10:30)
- Midday (11:30–14:30)
- Late afternoon (16:00–18:30)

If you can share 2–3 windows that work for you, I’ll lock one in and send a calendar invite (and include the hiring manager). Attached is a short role brief.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
(Attachment: role_brief.pdf)
